HAWK-EYED ARCHER
CR 8

XP 4,800
Human slayer (sniper) 8
NG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +3; Senses Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +1 deflection, +5 armor)
hp 64 (8d10+8+8)
Fort +8, Ref +10, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 longsword +14/+9 (1d8+8 S, 19–20/×2)
Ranged +2 shock composite longbow +15/+10 (1d8+7/×3 P plus 1d6 electricity)
Special Attacks accuracy, deadly sniper, sneak attack +2d6, studied target (2 targets, +2)

STATISTICS

Str 20 (+5), Dex 16 (+3), Con 12 (+1), Int 8 (–1), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +8; CMB +13; CMD 27
Feats Clustered Shots, Deadly Aim, Point Blank Master APG (B), Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot (B), Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (longbow)
Skills Bluff +10, Knowledge (local) +10, Perception +17, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +13, Survival +12
Languages Common
SQ slayer talents (ranger combat feats [archery ×2], rogue talents [snap shot APG, sniper’s eye APG]), stalker
Gear +1 chain shirt, +3 composite longbow [+5 Str] with 40 arrows, +1 longsword, cloak of resistance +1, eyes of the eagle, lesser bracers of archery, ring of protection +1, 25 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Accuracy (Ex)

A sniper halves all range increment penalties when making ranged attacks with a bow, crossbow, or firearm.

Deadly Range (Ex)

When the sniper makes an attack against a target who is within their weapon’s first range increment and completely unaware of their presence, that attack ignores the 30-foot range limit on ranged sneak attacks, and if it is a sneak attack, they adds their slayer level as a bonus on their sneak attack damage roll. After this first attack, the target is aware of the sniper’s presence.
